    Ptg[]
    XSSFEvaluationWorkbook.getFormulaTokens(EvaluationCell evalCell)
    The parsed tokens are cached by the XSSFEvaluationSheet the cell belongs to, so a formula is parsed once per evaluator rather than every time it is (re-)evaluated; the cache is kept in step by XSSFEvaluationWorkbook.clearAllCachedResultValues() and the sheet's notifyUpdateCell/notifyDeleteCell.
